description: Localisation et accessibilité des arrêts de bus is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Commune de Saint-Paul-lès-Dax. This dataset lists bus stops on the territory of the city of Saint-Paul-lès-Dax.It consists of a list of geo-located points on OpenStreetMap accompanied by information on accessibility, the equipment present at the stop level (podotactile band, presence trash, shelter, etc.), the photo of the stop, etc. This data comes from OpenStreetMap. Coverage: Commune de Saint-Paul-lès-Dax. The portal shows the English title as "Location and accessibility of bus stops" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Commune de Saint-Paul-lès-Dax. Its keywords include transport, accessibilite, arret, mobilite, deplacement, bus. The listing shows 3 download or service links in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The listing shows 2019-06-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
